Completely show the full body of the character in T-pose. Standing upright, facing forward. Arms raise horizontally at shoulder height. Palms facing down, remove handheld objects but keep hand-worn equipment and accessories. Legs straight, feet shoulder-width apart. Keep natural body proportions and anatomy. Front view, neutral background.
A new character: an amateur football player, a Lebanese American man in his mid forties, a slow, burly quarterback with a cannon of an arm: tall and barrel-chested with very thick upper arms and forearms, a solid belly and heavy slow legs, olive skin, short thick curly black hair, heavy black eyebrows, a strong curved nose, a square jaw dark with stubble and a proud, confident closed-mouth smile, wearing bright red sneakers. He wears exactly the same kit as the character in image[1] (plain white short-sleeved jersey, plain mid grey shorts, dark charcoal grey socks) and is made in exactly the same hand-sculpted clay art style, surface texture, level of detail, lighting and background as image[1], but is a completely different person: a different face, skin colour, hair, age and body, with no grey hair, no beard, no scowl and no old face: black hair and a proud younger face. Full body, front view, standing upright in a T-pose with arms straight out to the sides, palms down, fingers slightly apart, legs slightly apart. Stylized 3D cartoon character, an everyday person rather than an athlete, with a slightly big head, slightly oversized hands and shoes, smooth matte clay look, a detailed and expressive face, sculpted chunky hair, soft folds in the clothes, and well-defined hands, elbows and knees. The kit: a loose short-sleeved football jersey in plain near-white, pants ending just below the knee in plain mid grey, long socks in plain dark grey, each one flat colour with no logos, no numbers, no text, no stripes and no trim in another colour. Bare arms and bare hands, no helmet, no pads. Mouth closed. Matte, no gloss. Flat, even lighting. Single isolated figure on a plain flat blue-grey background, no floor shadow, no props.
